title: Auth Control Plane session record (v1 wire format)
description: The session as the auth-service serves it (CHAOS-3275 Wave 2). `revision` is the successor of today's users.token_version: a session whose revision is behind the principal's is stale. The contract is subtractive: credential values, hashes, passwords, provider tokens, e-mail addresses and network addresses have no field, and additionalProperties:false makes that absence enforceable (TRD section 18, G-16, G-17). The refresh credential is stored hashed by the service and is deliberately absent here.

schema_version.description: Contract identifier. A reader MUST reject an unrecognised value (G-26: unknown denies); additive evolution stays in v1 (TRD section 21).

session_id.description: Opaque server-minted session identifier. An identifier, never a secret, and never copied from caller input.

principal_id.description: The principal this session authenticates (principal.v1 principal_id).

revision.description: Session/principal revision. Integer token only; a decimal-form token is refused by every client (README, integer guard).

auth_time.description: When the user actually authenticated. Not later than created_at (client-enforced).

amr.description: Authentication methods: the RFC 8176 values of principal.v1 authentication.methods, plus "fed" (federated or social sign-in through an external identity provider; not an RFC 8176 value). Closed set.

created_at.description: When the session record was created.

expires_at.description: Absolute session expiry. Strictly after created_at (client-enforced).

revoked_at.description: Revocation instant, or null while the session is live. Required (not omitted) so a reader cannot confuse 'live' with 'field dropped'. Not before created_at (client-enforced).
